targeting.title: How we find the right audience
targeting.hint: Hover or tap a card to see the explanation.

items.name: GEO
items.text: Country, region or available local geography.
items.more: We show ads only where your audience lives and do not spend budget on extra countries.

items.name: Language
items.text: Language parameters of the audience and the Telegram interface.
items.more: We narrow delivery by language so the creative is read by the audience it was written for.

items.name: Interests
items.more: We pick interests close to your product and check which of them bring leads.

items.name: Topics
items.text: Placement in the context of the right topics.
items.more: The ad appears next to channels on topics where your offer is expected.

items.name: Specific channels
items.text: Targeting the audience / context of selected channels.
items.more: We choose channels by hand: an audience that already reads the right authors is the warmest.

items.name: Audiences
items.text: Available audience segments depending on the cabinet type.
items.more: We use ready-made audience segments that your type of ad cabinet opens up.
